newsitem.title: ROMANIA: BUCHAREST SHARE PRICES UP, INDICES AT YEAR HIGH.
newsitem.headline: BUCHAREST SHARE PRICES UP, INDICES AT YEAR HIGH.

text.p: Buying pressure sent most
Bucharest share prices up on Thursday, driving two independent
market indices to year highs.
"A rather bullish mood started today, especially on the
first tier and I expect it to continue at next week's first
trading session on Tuesday," a trader said.
The VAB and the BIG indices rose by 3.7 and 3.9 percent
respectively from the previous session to 568.6 and 578.14
points. The BIG first-tier index climbed by 5.29 percent to
1,883.54 points.
The first tier took centre-stage, taking more than 87
percent of a turnover level of 3.2 billion lei.
Traders said the drop in turnover from a previous 4.0
billion was a result of a smaller number of accumulated orders
in the market.
Three high-caps and another 10 stocks on the second tier
drifted higher, seven stocks fell, six remained unchanged and
one had no trade.
Five companies remained suspended pending release of
details on their stockholders' meeting.
Azomures fertiliser maker closed slighly stronger
at 1,880 lei, while chemical plant Oltchim gained 20
lei to close at 1,370.
But the first-tier's biggest gainer was Antibiotice
pharmaceuticals company, which firmed to 4,000 lei,
500 up on the previous level.
"Existing Antibiotice supply could not meet the mounting
demand for the stock," said a broker, adding that he saw
further rises ahead for the Antibiotice price.
The other pharmaceuticals firm on the first tier, Terapia, stayed flat at 3,300 lei.
Second-tier trading was subdued, with Policolor
dye maker staying in the focus but losing 50 lei to close at
Over-the-counter market trading details were not
immediately available.
-- Luli Popescu, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
